## Classification
- EXACT_SHA: identical commit object exists in Recovery.
- SAME_PATCH_SAME_HOUR: same stable patch-id and same UTC hour.
- SAME_PATCH_DIFFERENT_TIME: same patch-id but different UTC hour.
- UNMATCHED: no matching patch found in Recovery during the period.
- NO_COMPARABLE_PATCH: empty or non-comparable patch; requires review.

## Important methodology
- Committer timestamps determine inclusion in the date window.
- Author and committer timestamps are both recorded.
- Exact SHA and stable patch-id are compared independently.
- Patch-id matches are evidence of equivalent Git patches, not proof of complete feature equivalence.
- Merge commits are compared against their first parent for patch-id.
- Changed file lists are recorded for every examined commit.
- No branch was merged, deleted, or rewritten.
- No application code or database was modified.
